services.name: Cabana Rental
services.desc: Reserve a private cabana during your stay. Your private cabana can seat 5 comfortably at a time and includes 4 bottles of water, 4 club towels, and 2 deck lounge chairs. A Cabana reservation guarantees access and allows for re-entry privileges into the Hot Springs Pool. blurb: A source of relaxation, exhilaration, and breathtaking vistas, we are one of the original attractions in Colorado. Our historical setting is located between Aspen and Vail, just a short walk across the pedestrian bridge to Glenwood Springs.
